text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementHealthCyborg Roaches Could Be the Future of Triage MedicineThe augmented insects could deliver life-saving care to disaster victimsJCBy Jake Currie9:00 AM CDT on August 28, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleAustralia has a reputation for harboring some particularly heinous wildlife. There are more than 100 species of venomous snakes, saltwater crocodiles, creeping tarantulas, and the giant burrowing cockroach. This massive insect (the world’s heaviest) can grow over three inches long.
